# Fabricio Porcelli - Software Developer (AI & Data)

> Portfolio of Fabricio Porcelli, a software developer focused on Python, backend, databases and AI. The site is available in English and Spanish.

Site: https://portfolio.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/

## Projects

### Self-Hosted Homelab
Page: https://portfolio.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/projects/homelab.html

Self-hosted infrastructure running all my applications on a home server with Ubuntu Server LTS, Docker, and Coolify. Cloudflare handles DNS, HTTPS, and a tunnel (cloudflared) that publishes services without opening router ports or needing a public IP, while Traefik routes each subdomain to its container and Tailscale provides private admin access.

Stack: Ubuntu Server, Docker, Coolify, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, DNS, Self-Hosting

### SIR - Repair Shop Management System
Page: https://portfolio.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/projects/sir.html
Repository: private
Status: in development

Local-first web app that manages the full lifecycle of a repair shop: intake, diagnosis, quotes, repairs, payments, pickup, and customer notifications. It replaces a decades-old Visual FoxPro system with a self-hosted FastAPI + SQLite backend and a React + TypeScript frontend running on the shop's LAN, with local data and automatic backups.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, SQLite, Self-Hosting, Full-Stack

### Conviene - Supermarket Price Comparator
Page: https://portfolio.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/projects/conviene.html
Live: https://conviene.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/
Repository: private
Status: in development

Full-stack price comparator for supermarkets in Rosario. Search any product across seven online catalogs, compare prices and stock, browse bank promotions from eight chains, and save favorites, payment methods and followed products. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Redis on the backend and React + TypeScript on the frontend, self-hosted with Docker.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Redis, React, TypeScript, Docker

### Weather Dashboard
Page: https://portfolio.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/projects/weather-dashboard.html
Live: https://weather.fabricioporcelli.com.ar/
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/weather-dashboard

Interactive weather dashboard with a full-screen Leaflet map, city search, geolocation, current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, light/dark themes, and an AI chat. Built with vanilla JavaScript and ES Modules, it consumes the Weather API and the Weather Assistant, with loading/error states and a responsive mobile layout.

Stack: JavaScript, Leaflet, REST API, Vanilla JS, SSE, Playwright

### Weather Assistant
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/weather-assistant

LLM-powered weather assistant built on top of Weather API. Combines deterministic advice rules (umbrella, clothing, watering) with a tool-calling agent, SSE streaming chat with persistent sessions and history, activity scoring, and best-day ranking. Includes 313 offline tests and an LLM evaluation suite measuring tool selection and groundedness.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, LLM Agent, Tool Calling, SSE, PostgreSQL, Docker, Pytest

### Weather API Wrapper
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/weather-api

REST API in Python (FastAPI) that wraps the Visual Crossing weather service and exposes current weather, forecast, and history through a stable, versioned contract. Features Redis caching with per-datatype TTL, IP rate limiting, Pydantic validation, and 26 tests that run without network or Redis. Docker Compose spins up the API and Redis with a single command.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, REST API, Redis, Docker, Pytest, Caching

### Agentic Multi-Source RAG
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/NLP-TUIA-TF

Engineered an intelligent conversational assistant using Agentic RAG architecture. Integrated vector (ChromaDB/FAISS), tabular, and graph databases to enable multi-source information retrieval, serving responses through lightweight LLMs via REST APIs.

Stack: Agentic RAG, ChromaDB, FAISS, Graph DBs, LangChain, LLM APIs, NLP

### Data Warehousing & Business Intelligence
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/BBDD2-TUIA-TF

Designed and built an end-to-end ETL pipeline using MS Visual Studio (SSIS) to ingest and transform relational data into a Data Warehouse (MS SQL Server), developing interactive analytical dashboards in Power BI for decision-making.

Stack: ETL, SSIS, MS SQL Server, Data Warehousing, Power BI, SQL

## Older projects

### Solar Energy Forecasting (Machine Learning & MLOps)
Live: https://solar-energy-forecasting-app.streamlit.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/Solar-Energy-Forecasting

Developed and deployed a time-series forecasting model for solar power generation based on meteorological data. Handled feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning using Scikit-Learn/Pandas, productizing the solution via a real-time Streamlit web app.

Stack: Python, Machine Learning, Forecasting, Streamlit, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, MLOps

### Computer Vision & Facial Recognition
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/tuia-face-recognition-app

Developed real-time computer vision applications utilizing OpenCV and Deep Learning architectures (CNNs/Transfer Learning) for face detection, dog breed classification, and feature extraction.

Stack: Python, OpenCV, Deep Learning, CNNs, Transfer Learning, Computer Vision

### Dog Breed Recognition System
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/tuia-dog-recognition-app

Complete Computer Vision pipeline integrating embedding extraction, similarity search, supervised classification, and object detection to identify dog breeds in images. Features a Gradio frontend, async FastAPI backend, and Docker Compose deployment.

Stack: Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Embeddings, Gradio, Docker, YOLO, ResNet, CNN

### AgroVision-Edge | Crop vs Weed Detection
Live: https://agrovisionedge.streamlit.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/weed-detection

Edge-ready computer vision system using YOLOv8n to distinguish crops from weeds with mAP50=0.904. Optimized for on-device inference via ONNX export and INT8 quantization, cutting model size by 42% (6.25 → 3.60 MB) with only 1.84 mAP points lost. Includes CLI and an interactive Streamlit demo.

Stack: Computer Vision, YOLO, Edge AI, ONNX, INT8 Quantization, Streamlit, PyTorch

### Agricultural Yield Forecasting
GitHub: https://github.com/FabricioPorcelli/yield-forecasting

Prediction of agricultural yield (kg/ha) by province and campaign in Argentina, combining historical crop statistics from the Ministry of Agriculture (SIIA) with NASA POWER climate data. Daily weather is aggregated into phenological phases for soybeans, using a reusable pipeline designed to scale to other crops.

Stack: Python, Time Series, Forecasting, Pandas, Geopandas, NASA POWER, Feature Engineering
